title: 第一卷 第13章 离开镇北侯府绝不回头第一卷 第14章 天才炼丹师苏晴雨
lines: “你们两个混账，居然敢对长辈不敬，来人啊，给我家法伺候！”
周丽婷一脸狠厉之色。
她正愁找不到教训叶无尘的理由呢！
而今，这小子算是撞上枪口了。
叶英雄当即将叶无尘护在身后，一脸英勇道：“表弟如今才三岁，他还不懂事，要罚就罚我一人吧！”
叶无尘自然不会任由叶英雄吃亏，当即站出道：“周丽婷，我看对长辈不敬的人是你吧？我们可从未说过老巫婆是老夫人，我们明明背地里骂的是你才对！”
“表弟可真聪明，这一手祸水东引太漂亮了！”
叶英雄悄悄给叶无尘竖起了一个大拇指，立即帮腔道：“就是，我们对老夫人向来尊敬，又怎么背地里说她坏话呢，反倒是你，明面上好似尊敬老夫人，实际心里面却认为她是个老巫婆！”
周丽婷顿时被说懵了，满头大汗解释道：“我，我没有啊，母亲大人，我绝对没认为您是老巫婆，这两个小孩分明是巧舌如簧，在这里诡辩！”
“够了，都住嘴！”
老夫人发出怒斥，心想这周丽婷当真愚蠢，居然被一个小孩忽悠得团团转。
这时，叶琉璃听见吵闹声，自茅屋中走出，看向老夫人道：“不知老夫人莅临这荒凉后山，有何事指点？”
老夫人也是有头有脸，爱面子的人，此刻见到叶琉璃本人后，竟有些不知道该如何开这口。
不过一想到为了麒麟孙的前程，她还是狠下心来道：“琉璃啊，今日来此，是有事情与你商议。”
“商议何事？”
叶琉璃看了周丽婷一眼，心想这二人一起前来准没好事。
果不其然，老夫人斟酌着语气道：“琉璃啊，你一向大度明事理，这些年住在这西院后山实在委屈了，不如，不如你带着尘儿先去娘家住一阵子？”
叶琉璃顿时冷笑道：“呵呵，这是要将我赶出侯府吗？”
周丽婷一副苦口婆心的口吻道：“琉璃妹妹，话别说得这么难听嘛，只是让你去娘家住一阵子，怎么就成赶出侯府了？”
“看来今天你们是图穷匕见了呀，我住在这西院后山之地都碍着你们眼了吗？”
叶琉璃不断摇头，只觉得这二人嘴脸已丑陋到了极致。
叶英雄涨红着脸愤怒道：“就是，小姑这些年来不争不抢，处处忍让，你们竟还要得寸进尺，是不是太过分了！”
老夫人一脸尴尬道：“琉璃啊，你先别急着生气，昨日有一位算命先生算了一卦，说尘儿与牧儿天生命里犯冲，不宜待在一起成长，否则将会引来厄运，所以我的意思是，你带着尘儿去叶府居住一段时间，如此对尘儿对牧儿都好！”
“什么叫对尘儿好？我看老夫人你的眼里分明是只有牧儿吧？”
叶琉璃早已经看清楚了这位老夫人的嘴脸，对方心里想什么，她门清着呢。
眼见自己的小心思被拆穿，老夫人不禁恼羞成怒道：“叶琉璃，老身现在是在与你好好商议，你什么态度！”
“分明是你们强人所难，现在却问我什么态度？”
叶琉璃怒极反笑道：“想要将我赶出侯府可以，但你们总要给一个合适的理由吧？仅仅一个算命先生的话，就能决定我的去留，那我是不是也太卑贱了？”
老夫人当即强调道：“没有要将你赶出侯府的意思，只是让你带着尘儿去叶家小住一段时间，你什么时候想回来了，你可以再回来。”
叶琉璃其实早就不想在这侯府待着了，唯一的顾虑只有自己的孩子叶无尘。
叶无尘似乎也看出了娘亲的顾虑，当即道：“娘亲，这侯府早已没有我们母子二人的容身之地了，离开就离开吧，这委屈咱们不受了！”
“尘儿！”
content_en:
"You two bastards, how dare you be disrespectful to your elders, come on, please serve me according to the law!"
Zhou Liting had a fierce look on her face.
She was worried that she couldn't find a reason to teach Ye Wuchen a lesson!
Now, this kid has hit the point of a gun.
Ye Yingxiong immediately protected Ye Wuchen behind him and said with a brave face: "My cousin is only three years old now. He is not sensible yet. If you want to punish me, just punish me!"
Naturally, Ye Wuchen would not let Ye Yingxiong suffer, and immediately stood up and said: "Zhou Liting, I think you are the one who is disrespectful to the elders, right? We never said that the old witch is an old lady, we are clearly scolding you behind your back!"
"My cousin is so smart. This way of diverting trouble to the east is so beautiful!"
Ye Yingxiong quietly gave Ye Wuchen a thumbs up and immediately said, "That's right, we always respect the old lady, so how can we say bad things about her behind her back? On the contrary, you, on the surface, seem to respect the old lady, but in your heart you think she is an old witch!"
Zhou Liting was immediately confused. She was sweating profusely and explained: "I, I didn't, mother, I definitely didn't think you were an old witch. These two children are obviously eloquent and sophistical here!"
"That's enough, everyone, shut up!"
The old lady scolded angrily, thinking that Zhou Liting was really stupid for being fooled by a child.
At this time, Ye Liuli heard the noise, walked out of the hut, looked at the old lady and said: "I wonder if the old lady comes to this desolate back mountain, what can I give you?"
The old lady was also a respectable and face-saving person. Now that she saw Ye Liuli in person, she didn't know how to speak.
However, when she thought about Qilin Sun's future, she still made up her mind and said: "Liu Li, I came here today to discuss something with you."
"What are we discussing?"
Ye Liuli glanced at Zhou Liting and thought that it would be bad for them to come together.
As expected, the old lady considered her tone and said: "Liu Li, you have always been generous and sensible. Living in the back of the west courtyard these years has been really unfair. How about you take Chen'er to your parents' house to live for a while?"
Ye Liuli immediately sneered and said: "Haha, are you trying to drive me out of the Hou Mansion?"
Zhou Liting said in a sincere tone: "Sister Liuli, don't speak so harshly. I'm just asking you to stay at your parents' house for a while. How can you be kicked out of the Hou Mansion?"
"It seems that you are just trying to meet each other today. Am I bothering you by living in the mountains behind the west courtyard?"
Ye Liuli kept shaking his head, feeling that the faces of these two people were extremely ugly.
Ye Yingxiong blushed and said angrily: "That's right, my sister-in-law has not fought or grabbed, and tolerated everything over the years, but you still want to go even further, isn't it too much!"
The old lady looked embarrassed and said: "Liu Li, don't get angry in a hurry. Yesterday, a fortune teller made a prediction and said that Chen'er and Mu'er are in conflict with each other in their lives and should not stay together to grow up. Otherwise, they will bring bad luck. So what I mean is that you take Chen'er to live in Ye Mansion for a while. This will be good for both Chen'er and Mu'er!"
"What does it mean to be nice to Chen'er? I see, old madam, you only have eyes for Mu'er, right?"
Ye Liuli had already seen the old lady's face clearly, and she didn't know what she was thinking.
Seeing that her little thoughts were revealed, the old lady couldn't help but became angry and said: "Ye Liuli, I am having a serious discussion with you now, what is your attitude!"
"It's obvious that you are forcing others to do something difficult, but now you ask me what my attitude is?"
Ye Liuli laughed angrily and said, "You can drive me out of the Marquis Mansion, but you have to give me a suitable reason, right? Just a fortune teller can decide my stay, so am I too humble?"
The old lady immediately emphasized: "I have no intention of kicking you out of the Hou Mansion. I just want you to take Chen'er to the Ye family to stay for a while. If you want to come back, you can come back."
In fact, Ye Liuli no longer wanted to stay in the Marquis Mansion. Her only concern was for her child Ye Wuchen.
Ye Wuchen seemed to have noticed his mother's concerns, and immediately said: "Mother, there is no place for us, mother and son, in this Marquis Mansion. Just leave, we can't bear this grievance!"
"Chen'er!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 13: Never look back after leaving Zhenbei Hou Mansion Volume 1 Chapter 14: Genius Alchemist Su Qingyu
